TileStructure.Forest.statement: Let $X$ be a pseudometric space. Let $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\to X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$ and $F,G\subseteq X$, and assume a structure $\mathrm{ProofData}(a,q,K,\sigma_1,\sigma_2,F,G)$ on $X$ (docstring: data common through most of chapters 2-7). It consists of: (i) a $\mathrm{KernelProofData}(a,K)$ structure, i.e. a doubling metric measure space structure $\mathrm{DoublingMeasure}(X,2^a)$ ($X$ is complete and locally compact and carries a measure $\mu$ (`volume`) on a Borel $\sigma$-algebra which is locally finite, nonzero and satisfies $\mu(B(x,2r))\le 2^a\mu(B(x,r))$ for all $x\in X$, $r\in\mathbb R$, $B$ denoting open balls), the condition $4\le a$, a structure $\mathrm{CompatibleFunctions}(\mathbb R,X,2^a)$ (which provides a type $\Theta(X)$ of continuous real-valued functions on $X$ together with, for each $x\in X$ and $r\in\mathbb R$, a pseudometric $d_{x,r}$ on $\Theta(X)$, subject to the compatibility axioms of that structure), and the condition $\mathrm{IsOneSidedKernel}(a,K)$ (the one-sided Calderón–Zygmund kernel conditions); (ii) the condition $\mathrm{IsCancellative}(X,1/a)$ ($\Theta(X)$ is $1/a$-cancellative); (iii) $q\in(1,2]$; (iv) $F$ and $G$ are bounded and measurable; (v) $\sigma_1,\sigma_2$ are measurable with finite ranges and $\sigma_1\le\sigma_2$ pointwise; (vi) a simple function $Q:X\to\Theta(X)$; and (vii) for every $\theta\in\Theta(X)$, the linearized nontangential operator $T_Q^\theta=\mathrm{linearizedNontangentialOperator}(Q,\theta,K)$ satisfies $\mathrm{HasBoundedStrongType}(T_Q^\theta,2,2,\mu,\mu,2^{a^3})$ (for every $g:X\to\mathbb C$ that is a.e.-strongly measurable, essentially bounded and nonzero only on a set of finite $\mu$-measure, $T_Q^\theta g$ is a.e.-strongly measurable and $\|T_Q^\theta g\|_{L^2(\mu)}\le 2^{a^3}\|g\|_{L^2(\mu)}$). Let $\mathsf b\in\mathbb N$ be the project constant `𝕔` (per its docstring fixed equal to $100$), $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)=2^{\mathsf b a^2}$, $\kappa=\mathrm{default}\kappa(a)=2^{-10a}$, $o=\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)\in X$ (a point, chosen by the axiom of choice, at which every function in $\Theta(X)$ vanishes), and $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)\in\mathbb N$ the least natural number $m>0$ such that $-m\le\sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x)\le m$ for all $x\in X$ and $F,G\subseteq B(o,D^m/4)$. Assume a tile structure $\mathrm{TileStructure}(Q,D,\kappa,S,o)$ on $X$; it provides a grid structure on $X$ with a finite type $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ of dyadic cubes, each cube $I$ having an underlying set (also written $I\subseteq X$), a scale $s(I)\in\mathbb Z$ and a center $c(I)\in X$; a finite type $\mathfrak P(X)$ of tiles with a surjective map $\mathcal I:\mathfrak P(X)\to\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ and a map $\mathcal Q:\mathfrak P(X)\to\Theta(X)$ whose range lies in the range of $Q$; and a map $\Omega$ from tiles to subsets of $\Theta(X)$; all subject to the axioms of the structures `GridStructure`, `PreTileStructure` and `TileStructure`. For a tile $p$ write $\mathfrak c(p)=c(\mathcal I(p))$ and $\mathfrak s(p)=s(\mathcal I(p))$. Cubes are partially ordered by $I\le J$ iff $I\subseteq J$ (as sets) and $s(I)\le s(J)$; tiles are partially ordered by $p\le p'$ iff $(\mathcal I(p),\Omega(p))\le(\mathcal I(p'),\Omega(p'))$ in the project partial order `instPartialOrderTileLike` on $\mathrm{TileLike}(X)=\mathrm{Grid}(X)\times(\text{subsets of }\Theta(X))^{\mathrm{op}}$. For $l\in\mathbb R$ and a tile $p$ let $\mathrm{smul}(l,p)=(\mathcal I(p),\,B_{\mathfrak c(p),D^{\mathfrak s(p)}/4}(\mathcal Q(p),l))\in\mathrm{TileLike}(X)$, where $B_{x,r}(\vartheta,l)$ is the open ball of radius $l$ about $\vartheta$ for the pseudometric $d_{x,r}$ on $\Theta(X)$. For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{Forest}(X,n)$ is the type (docstring: an $n$-forest) of structures consisting of a set of tiles $\mathfrak U\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ and a map $\mathfrak T$ assigning to each tile $u$ a set of tiles $\mathfrak T(u)\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ (only relevant for $u\in\mathfrak U$), such that: (1) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$, $\mathfrak T(u)$ is nonempty; (2) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$, $\mathfrak T(u)$ is order-connected (if $p\le p'\le p''$ with $p,p''\in\mathfrak T(u)$ then $p'\in\mathfrak T(u)$); (3) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$ and $p\in\mathfrak T(u)$, $\mathcal I(p)\neq\mathcal I(u)$; (4) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$ and $p\in\mathfrak T(u)$, $\mathrm{smul}(4,p)\le\mathrm{smul}(1,u)$; (5) for every $x\in X$, $\mathrm{stackSize}(\mathfrak U,x)\le 2^n$, where $\mathrm{stackSize}(\mathfrak U,x)=\#\{p\in\mathfrak U: x\in\mathcal I(p)\}$; (6) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$, $\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))\le 2^{4a-n+1}$ (in $[0,\infty]$); (7) for all $u,u'\in\mathfrak U$ with $u\neq u'$ and every $p\in\mathfrak T(u')$ with $\mathcal I(p)\le\mathcal I(u)$, $2^{Z(n+1)}<d_{\mathfrak c(p),D^{\mathfrak s(p)}/4}(\mathcal Q(p),\mathcal Q(u))$, where $Z=\mathrm{defaultZ}(a)=2^{12a}$; (8) for every $u\in\mathfrak U$ and $p\in\mathfrak T(u)$, $B(\mathfrak c(p),8D^{\mathfrak s(p)})\subseteq\mathcal I(u)$. Here, for a set of tiles $\mathfrak P'$, $$\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak P')=\sup_{p'\in\mathfrak P'}\ \sup_{\lambda\in\mathbb R_{\ge0},\,\lambda\ge2}\ \lambda^{-a}\sup\Big\{\frac{\mu(E_2(\lambda,p))}{\mu(\mathcal I(p))}: p\in\mathrm{lowerCubes}(\mathfrak P'),\ \mathrm{smul}(\lambda,p')\le\mathrm{smul}(\lambda,p)\Big\}\in[0,\infty],$$ with $\mathrm{lowerCubes}(\mathfrak P')=\{p\in\mathfrak P(X):\exists p'\in\mathfrak P',\ \mathcal I(p)\le\mathcal I(p')\}$ and $E_2(\lambda,p)=\mathcal I(p)\cap G\cap Q^{-1}\big(B_{\mathfrak c(p),D^{\mathfrak s(p)}/4}(\mathcal Q(p),\lambda)\big)$ (division in $[0,\infty]$).
